label: retailer sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: The shop showed a block page for automated traffic (We have noticed some unusual activity). Not counted as an accessibility result.

reclassified.why: The shop showed a block page for automated traffic (We have noticed some unusual activity).

findings.problem: The only page offered is a block message saying unusual activity was noticed and automated traffic is not allowed. There is no search, no navigation, no products and no cart, so shopping is impossible.

element.name: We have noticed some unusual activity

findings.problem: The first element is a link containing only an unlabeled image, so a screen reader user hears an empty link with no name and cannot tell where it goes.

The only way forward is a phone number link for customer service, and nothing explains how a person using assistive technology can get past the block. Reading the page again at step 2 showed the same content.
